description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
>本参数需要和**SecretName**一起传入。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

>  If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the **SecretName** parameter. parameter.

description.zh:
数据库类型。

> 该参数当前仅支持传入MySQL值。
description.en:
The engine of the database.

> Only MySQL is supported.

description.zh: 地域ID，可通过调用DescribeSecrets接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeSecrets operation to query the region ID.
The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID.

description.zh:
已创建的Data API账号的用户凭证，可通过调用createSecret接口获取该参数的值。
>**SecretName**和本参数必须传入其一。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the credential for the created Data API account. You can call the CreateSecret operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

>  You must specify one of the SecretArn and **SecretName** parameters.

description.zh:
用户凭证名称。

> * **SecretArn**和本参数必须传入其一。
> * 本参数需要和**DbInstanceId**一起传入。
description.en:
The name of the credential.

> *   You must specify one of **SecretArn** and SecretName.
> *   If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DbInstanceId**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds delete-secret --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:rds:cn-hangzhou:1335786000:dbInstance/rm-bp1m7l3j630000 --secret-name Foo --engine MySQL --db-instance-id rm-sfjdlsjxxxxx --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
